India-China trade resumes via Lipulekh Pass after 6 years

Trade between India and China has resumed via the Lipulekh Pass after a six-year hiatus. The route, located in Dharchula, was reopened after being closed for seven hours. This reopening is expected to accelerate cross-border trade.
